summary: Wrote docs/conversational-memory-design.md (committed cf2b4f7 on orch/attempt/...-41). Design-only, no engine code. RECOMMENDED ARCHITECTURE (5 bullets): (1) Zonoid ALREADY owns the hard temporal substrate — bi-temporal validFrom/validTo + transaction-time (created_at/knownAsOf, comment literally calls it "the Zep gap" closed), non-destructive supersedeNote chain, as-of/history retrieval, subsumption (findSubsumedNotes 0.92) + outcome-grounded decay/reinforce (a surplus Zep lacks). Gap tally: 7 HAVE, 5 PARTIAL, 2 MISSING. (2) The 2 MISSING pieces: a conversational DISTILLER (session transcript → atomic facts as notes + entities, off the hot path, Mem0 ADD/UPDATE/NOOP as ref but UPDATE→supersedeNote so history is non-destructive) and an ENTITY layer (new `entity` node kind reusing note bi-temporal fields; entity↔note + entity↔entity edges carried as kind:context + a `relation` field so existing weight/judged/structBoost/neighborhood machinery applies unchanged — no new edge kind, no new judge lane). (3) Temporal consistency = separate the TRIGGER from the MECHANISM: supersession mechanism is already correct; add a write-time CONTRADICTION gate (the one LLM call Graphiti also pays, off the read path) beside the existing subsumption gate, both terminating in supersedeNote. (4) Hybrid retrieval upgrade: replace scoreHybrid's either/or cosine-OR-lexical with RRF(semantic, BM25), and promote expandNeighborhood (already implemented in judge.js) into the /search read path as entity-seeded graph traversal — a strict superset of today's tiered pipeline. (5) DIFFERENTIATOR: unify the conversational graph WITH the task/execution graph in ONE bi-temporal graph joined by entity nodes (Zep/Mem0 are conversation-only and have no execution graph to unify with) — a distilled "user prefers X" fact is the same note kind the orchestrator already reads as task context + ask-gate preference corpus, so conversation immediately steers execution. FIRST INCREMENT: Phase 0 = LoCoMo/LongMemEval

subject: Design doc: Zep/Graphiti-referenced conversational-memory layer for Zonoid (distill → entity-wire → temporal-consistency graph, unified with the task graph)
description:
STRATEGIC DESIGN (design-first, before building). The bench proved our conversational KB is sparse — each session dumped as raw note-chunks, wired only by transient probe→note cosine, ZERO note→note structure. Mem0/Zep win on conversational memory because they DISTILL conversations into structured memory (Mem0: LLM fact-extraction + entity KG; Zep/Graphiti: temporal knowledge graph, entities+relations+time first-class). Direction (user): heavily reference ZEP/Graphiti and build a conversational-memory layer for Zonoid.

KEY LEVERAGE to make explicit: Zonoid ALREADY has the temporal substrate that is Graphiti's hard part — bi-temporal provenance (validFrom/validTo), supersession/supersededBy, subsumption/decay. So this is NOT building Graphiti from scratch; it's adding a conversational FRONT-END on top of the existing temporal graph. And the differentiation Zep lacks: unify conversational facts WITH the task/execution graph in one temporal graph.

Produce a design doc (style of docs/bench-sdk-design.md) covering:
1. Deep summary of Zep/Graphiti architecture (entity+fact extraction from messages, bi-temporal edges valid-time vs ingestion-time, fact invalidation/contradiction handling, hybrid retrieval = semantic + BM25 + graph traversal) — and Mem0's fact-extraction approach as a secondary reference. Cite sources.
2. Gap analysis: what Zonoid already has (map each Graphiti feature to the existing Zonoid mechanism) vs what's missing (the conversational distiller; entity nodes + entity→note/entity→entity edges; fact-level temporal consistency; hybrid retrieval).
3. Proposed architecture: the distiller (session → atomic facts + entities, not raw chunks), the wiring (entity nodes wired to notes AND tasks; relationship edges), temporal-consistency (fact validFrom/validTo, contradiction → supersede), retrieval (graph traversal + semantic over the structured facts).
4. How it plugs into the existing graph-store/overlay/judge without breaking the task path; the unified chat+task temporal-graph story.
5. A phased build plan (smallest first increment that would move the bench numbers).
Read-only research + design (WebSearch + read the Zonoid graph code: lib/graph-store.js, lib/judge.js, lib/overlay.js, routes/graph.js). NO code changes — design only. Commit the doc. Bounded; no long runs / no poll loops.
